answer: The delta counter is kept in summit and spiral exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 14 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 14 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Scaling to 439 identities multiplies that fee by 646 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
